consequence.statement: Deployability via ko is an additional deployment option for Crossplane; the evidence states no failure, rejection, ignored setting, lost permission or required migration, so an operator who does nothing experiences no operational change.

assertion.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 adds the ability to deploy Crossplane via ko.
